# Figma Developers

> > Official developer documentation for building Figma plugins, Code Connect integrations, and code layers in Figma Sites

Comprehensive technical resources for the Figma Plugin API, Code Connect framework, and code layer development. Covers React integration, component properties, variable bindings, node manipulation, and AI-powered workflows including the Figma MCP server.

## Key Topics

- Figma Plugin API
- Code Connect
- Figma Sites code layers
- React components
- Node types (BaseNode, DocumentNode, PageNode)
- Component properties and variants
- Variable bindings and theming
- Code generation (codegen)
- FigJam nodes
- MCP (Model Context Protocol)
- Document access and manipulation
- Instance swap
- Dev status tracking
- AI-assisted iteration
- Template API

## Plugin API Reference

- [Node Types](https://developers.figma.com/docs/plugins/api/nodes): Complete reference of Figma node types and layer properties
- [ComponentProperties](https://developers.figma.com/docs/plugins/api/ComponentProperties): API reference for component properties and variable bindings
- [ComponentPropertyDefinitions](https://developers.figma.com/docs/plugins/api/ComponentPropertyDefinitions): Component property definitions with variants and instance swap
- [ExtendedVariableCollection](https://developers.figma.com/docs/plugins/api/ExtendedVariableCollection): Enterprise variable collection properties and theming API
- [CodegenResult](https://developers.figma.com/docs/plugins/api/CodegenResult): API reference for code generation results with syntax highlighting
- [CodegenPreference](https://developers.figma.com/docs/plugins/api/CodegenPreference): Define custom codegen commands in Figma's plugin UI
- [EllipseNode](https://developers.figma.com/docs/plugins/api/EllipseNode): API reference for ellipse shape nodes and properties
- [HighlightNode](https://developers.figma.com/docs/plugins/api/HighlightNode): FigJam highlighter tool stickable node API reference
- [DevStatus](https://developers.figma.com/docs/plugins/api/DevStatus): API reference for node handoff and dev status tracking

## Plugin Development Guides

- [Accessing the Document](https://developers.figma.com/docs/plugins/accessing-document): Guide to accessing Figma document structure via Plugin API

## Code Connect

- [Template V2 API](https://developers.figma.com/docs/code-connect/template-v2-api): Custom Code Connect templates for component rendering control
- [Connecting code with template files](https://developers.figma.com/docs/code-connect/no-parser): Framework-agnostic Code Connect using JavaScript template files

## Figma Sites Code Layers

- [Create your first code layer](https://developers.figma.com/docs/code/create-your-first-code-layer): Getting started with code layers in Figma Sites editor
- [Props and variables](https://developers.figma.com/docs/code/props-and-variables): Implement React-style props and variables in code components
- [Iterate your code with AI](https://developers.figma.com/docs/code/iterate-your-code-with-ai): Import React code into Figma Make/Sites and iterate using AI

## Figma MCP Server

- [Code to canvas](https://developers.figma.com/docs/figma-mcp-server/code-to-canvas): Convert live browser UI to editable Figma frames via MCP server
- [Resources (Make → MCP)](https://developers.figma.com/docs/figma-mcp-server/bringing-make-context-to-your-agent): Bringing Make context to MCP agent workflows
